image_brief.subject: one single round flatbread disc, shaped exactly like a pita or naan bread: flat, round, golden-brown, with a smooth puffed surface and a few small scattered char spots, nothing else on or around it
image_brief.composition: centered, filling most of the frame, lying flat, viewed from directly above or a very gentle angle
image_brief.background: plain soft warm-tan background, nothing else in the scene
image_brief.cultural_notes: use the round flatbread-disc shape specifically (naan/pita silhouette) rather than a baguette, a sliced loaf, or a studded bun shape  -  the round flat disc is the single, unambiguous referent for this word
avoid: seeds or studded texture covering the surface
utensils or any other object in frame

image_brief.subject: a friendly cartoon cat sitting upright, orange tabby fur, tail curled around its paws
a friendly cartoon dog sitting, medium build, brown and white fur, tongue out happily
one single plain filled circle, like a round color swatch or paint dot, solid red all the way through with no gradient and no pattern
image_brief.composition: one circle only, centered in frame, large, filling most of the frame, perfectly plain and flat like a color sample
image_brief.background: plain solid white background, completely empty otherwise
image_brief.cultural_notes: a plain circle is used instead of a real-world object (a balloon, a fruit) specifically because any recognizable object teaches the child that object's name, not the color; a circle is the simplest common shape with no object identity of its own, so it functions purely as a color carrier
avoid: any recognizable object (fruit, balloon, ball with markings, etc.)
mosaic or collage of small shapes
any other color in the frame besides red
gradient or shading inside the circle

image_brief.subject: a warm cartoon mother figure, simple friendly rounded design, gentle smile, medium-length dark hair in a simple style, wearing a modest simple dress, Middle-Eastern-presenting features rendered in a soft stylized non-photorealistic way
image_brief.composition: centered, waist-up, facing forward, open welcoming gesture
image_brief.cultural_notes: Persian/Iranian heritage family  -  warm and dignified, modest styling; avoid Western stereotypical depictions (apron, blonde hair)

image_brief.subject: the same recurring cartoon child character used across all feeling words: round head, short black hair, warm tan skin, big round brown eyes, small round nose, no other characters  -  here with a big genuine smile, bright eyes, rosy cheeks
image_brief.cultural_notes: gender-neutral, stylized non-photorealistic child face; this exact character description must be reused verbatim (same hair, skin tone, eyes, nose) for 'scared' and 'sleepy' so the three feeling images read as one consistent character rather than three different children  -  SDXL does not hold character identity across separate generations on its own, so a fixed detailed description plus a fixed seed is the mitigation, not a guarantee
avoid: a different-looking character than the fixed description

image_brief.subject: the same recurring cartoon child character used across all feeling words: round head, short black hair, warm tan skin, big round brown eyes, small round nose, no other characters  -  here with a mildly surprised, wide-eyed nervous expression: raised eyebrows, small open mouth, gentle and non-distressing
image_brief.cultural_notes: SAFETY: must read as mild apprehension appropriate for a 4-7 year old, never genuine terror, crying, or distress  -  think 'a little surprised', not 'traumatized'
avoid: monsters or threatening objects in frame

image_brief.count_object_subject: a single simple five-pointed cartoon star, solid golden-yellow color with a thick outline
image_brief.cultural_notes: SDXL cannot reliably count objects or render numeral glyphs from a text prompt, so the count and the numeral are both produced deterministically in code (compose.py) from one generated star sticker, not asked of the model directly

image_brief.subject: one single round red balloon, so enormous it barely fits in the frame, its edges nearly touching all four sides
image_brief.composition: the balloon fills almost the entire frame, cropped slightly at the edges to emphasize its huge size, nothing else in the scene for scale
image_brief.cultural_notes: uses the same balloon object as the 'small' image (only the scale differs) so the pair reads as a matched contrasting set to a child; size is conveyed by how much of the frame the balloon fills, not by a side-by-side comparison, which SDXL cannot reliably keep two 'identical' objects consistent across

image_brief.subject: one single round red balloon, tiny, occupying only a small part of the frame

image_brief.cultural_notes: uses the exact same balloon object as the 'big' image (only the scale differs) so the pair reads as a matched contrasting set to a child

avoid: cat beside or on top of the table
